subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard permanently expose `status_changed` as a strictly opt-in durable notification contract with replay-stable transition IDs and additive SQLite retention?
rationale: This is a new exported plugin contract and persisted behavior. Code review cannot choose the desired long-term consumer, replay, ordering, and retention guarantees without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the durable opt-in contract
options.body: Keep the implementation and document `status_changed` as the supported replayable Workboard notification for consumers that explicitly request it.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Specify bounded retention or different notification guarantees before accepting a persisted event stream that downstream consumers may treat as durable.

options.title: Keep status observation external
options.body: Decline the core Workboard event and direct consumers to polling or a separate plugin-owned integration.

recommendation.title: Accept the durable opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Keep the implementation and document `status_changed` as the supported replayable Workboard notification for consumers that explicitly request it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository history provides the closest available signal for compatibility-sensitive SQLite design decisions.
